scripts.backend:build: npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.frontend:build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run export --prefix frontend
scripts.web:copy: rm -rf backend/public && mkdir -p backend/public && cp -r frontend/out/. backend/public/
scripts.web:sync: npm run backend:build && npm run frontend:build && npm run web:copy && npx cap sync android
